Commentary.Commentary: Right then. That's it from the coverage of this match. The action in the Women's T20 World Cup continues on 18th February, 2023. It is a double-header coming your way. It will an enticing clash between England Women and India Women to kick things off. This match will begin at 6.30 pm IST (1 pm GMT). Followed by a match between South Africa Women and Australia Women. This will commence at 10.30 pm IST (5 pm GMT). But you can join us early for the build-up. Until then, take care and goodbye!

Hayley Matthews, the victorious skipper wins the Player of the Match award for her match-winning knock. She starts by saying that she is happy to bat through the innings. Adds kudos to the Irish girls as they bowled really well. But she is also proud of her group here. Mentions she has taken up a new role here and has helped her a lot. She adds that it got pretty tight in the end but is happy that they could get over the line. Credits Karishma for her spell. Ends by saying that it is a complete team effort. Says that they are going through a transition phase and it is all about sticking together and building together.

Laura Delany, the skipper of Ireland Women is in for a chat. She says that they were pretty relaxed in the final over. Praises the batting effort of her side. Says there are a lot of nerves as most of the girls are playing their first ever World Cup. Lauds the effort of Orla and Gaby with the blade. Tells that the best is yet to come.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

Earlier in the innings, Ireland Women were on track to score above 160 runs but they lost wicket in a flurry in the death which left them with an under-par score. Only, Orla Prendergast and Gaby Lewis turned up with the bat for them. West Indies Women were lethal with the ball in the fag end of the innings. During the chase, it went down till the wire but West Indies Women managed to come out on top in the end.

Ireland Women would be a bit disappointed as they could not seal the game here. Ireland Women were unable to keep the pressure in the death overs and that cost them the game here. Also, things could've been completely different only if Ireland Women were much more clinical in the field. Well, they says "Catches win matches" and that's what the Irish could not do. Leah Paul and Laura Delany took a wicket each.

West Indies Women started the chase slowly but their skipper, Hayley Matthews has made sure to get her side over the victory line here. West Indies Women lost two wickets quite early and found it difficult to score runs with ease. Hayley Matthews though made the most of her reprieve. She was well supported by Chinelle Henry to get the innings back on track. There were some hiccups in the end but West Indies Women came out on the right side.

Phew! What a match this turned out to be. Ireland Women put in a run for their money but they are yet to record a win in the T20 World Cup. Nevertheless, Ireland Women would feel they are going on the right trajectory here to become a fine propect in the coming future. Delight for West Indies Women, as they walk back with two crucial points.
FOUR! Here are the winning runs. It is a length ball, outside off. Hayley Matthews rocks back and carves it over point for a cracking boundary. West Indies Women win by 6 wickets.

A length ball, that lands outside off and jags back in. Alleyne tries to glance it around the corner, but ends up playing all around it. The ball hits her on her pads and rolls out to the leg side. The batters take a leg bye. Ireland Women take a review but it does not go in their favour.

OUT! RUN OUT! WHAT IS HAPPENING! It is full and on leg. Shabika Gajnabi flicks it to short mid-wicket. The fielder there dives to her left and parries it to long on. Gaby Lewis charges in and throws it to the keeper. Mary Waldron collects and takes the bails off. Shabika Gajnabi is way short of the crease. Hayley Matthews is livid as she is left hanging on the non-striker's end here. Aaliyah Alleyne is the new batter in.
Goes full and on pads. Hayley Matthews now clips it to deep mid-wicket. One taken. West Indies Women are one hit away from victory. 4 needed off 4 balls.
A single off the first one! It is fuller, on leg. Shabika Gajnabi uses her feet and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single. Hayley Matthews is back on strike.
Full and on off. Hayley Matthews eases it back to the bowler. So, it goes down to the final over here.
Just short! It is full and on off. Shabika Gajnabi throws her blade at it. The ball catches the outside edge but it does not carry to the fielder at short third man as this is played with soft-hands.
Short, on fourth stump. Hayley Matthews goes back and dabs it to short third man. They take a single.
Fuller and on off. Shabika Gajnabi lifts it over the bowler's head. They take a single. West Indies Women now need less than a run a ball.
FOUR! Consecutive boundaries. Short one, outside off, swinging away a bit. Shabika Gajnabi rides the bounce and crunches it through covers for a boundary.
FOUR! Smacked! Pressure? What is pressure says Shabika Gajnabi. It is very full, on off. Shabika Gajnabi goes back and lofts it down the ground. It takes a couple of bounces over the ropes.
Short and on off. Shabika Gajnabi drags her pull shot to deep mid-wicket for a single. Shabika Gajnabi gets off the mark. West Indies Women need 17 runs off the final 2 overs.

OUT! CAUGHT! Leah Paul strikes to get her first. She is pumped up to see the back of Henry here. It is a full and on off. Henry ends up chipping it towards extra cover. Laura Delany there makes no mistake this time. Is there a twist in the tale?
Commentary.Howout: c Laura Delany b Leah Paul

Commentary.Commentary: Full and on off, defended back to the bowler.
This is punched to sweeper cover off the back foot for two runs.

FOUR! Dropped in the deep! It is short, wide of off. Henry rocks back and goes through with her cut shot. The ball takes the outside edge and flies towards deep point. The fielder in the deep fails to judge the ball and lets the ball go over her, as she runs in to quickly. It takes a bounce over the ropes.
Flatter and outside off. Hayley Matthews slices it towards backward point. There is a bit of a mix-up but no damage done in the end.
Full, on middle and leg. Henry shuffles and flicks it to the fielder at mid on.
Full length, on off. Hayley Matthews gets an inside edge on her boots. It rolls out to point and they cross.
Henry makes some room and punches this length ball towards sweeper cover. They take another single.
Full, tailing into the pads. Matthews tucks it in front of mid on for one more.
Hayley Matthews stays back to this full one and punches it to deep point. The call is for two and they get two.
FOUR! Hayley Matthews makes sure to start this over on a positive note. It is pitched up, outside off. Hayley Matthews stands tall and smacks it over extra cover for four runs. Top, top shot.
FOUR! This should ease down some nerves. It is a full toss, on off. Henry stands tall and smacks it over mid off for four runs. West Indies Women need 34 runs off 24 balls.
Three dots in a row! The asking rate now going up. Back of a length, outside off. Henry looks to cut it away but gets beaten on the outside edge.
On off, played straight to the fielder at mid off. It dies just before the fielder.
Much fuller, outside off. This one flies off the deck. Henry fails to smack it through the line.
Flatter and wide of off. Hayley Matthews smacks it to backward point. The fielder there makes a half-stop and allows a single.
Short and on off. Henry makes some room and slashes it to deep point for a single.
BEATEN! Shorter, outside off. Hayley Matthews tries to go after it but misses.

FOUR! Incredible shot. Hayley Matthews is playing a true captain's knock here. It is short, outside off. Hayley Matthews rocks back and plays the cut shot. He gets it through the gap past backward point. Hayley Matthews gets her seventh T20I half-ton. A crucial knock by the skipper. She still have a job in her hand here.
Short turning away from outside off. Hayley Matthews rocks back and cuts it to the right of extra cover. Murray dives to that side and makes a sharp stop.
WIDE! The umpire signals a wide as Kelly spills this full outside the tramline.
Length and on off pole. Henry stays back and carves it through the gap at covers. The batters take three runs before the fielder cuts it out.
Touch short, wide of off. Henry looks to chase it but misses.
Pushed through quicker and flat, on off. Hayley Matthews dabs it out to cover and crosses.
A length ball, outside off. Hayley Matthews tries to hit it through the line but gets an inside edge on her pads. The cross for a quick single. This is good running.
This length ball is punched off the back foot past extra cover. One taken.
FOUR! Nicely played. Orla Prendergast goes short, in the channel. Chinelle Henry waits for it, opens the face late, makes the most of the pace on offer and guides it down to the third man fence.
Good length, around off. Hayley Matthews taps it to point and scampers across for a quick single.
These two are making sure to keep the runs ticking. Goes full and on off. Henry makes room and punches it through cover-point.
It is full, on off stump. Hayley Matthews gets across and knocks it down the ground. She gets to the other end.
This is angled into the pads. Hayley Matthews flicks it to mid-wicket and retains the strike here.
On the pads, nudged to the leg side.
SIX! BANG! Hayley Matthews moves into her 40s. It is a short ball, on off. Hayley Matthews swivels on her back foot and launches it over the square leg fence.
Length and in the channel. Hayley Matthews gets it off the toe-end.
A single now as this is played down to long on.
A short one, on the bodyline. Henry swivels and pulls it to deep square leg. The batters take two with ease as the fielder in the deep fumbles.
Henry rocks back and cuts this short one to sweeper cover. They take a single.
On the pads, Matthews flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Swing and a miss! Looped up, outside off. Hayley Matthews tries to crunch it through the line but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Quicker and fuller, outside off. Gets some extra bounce off the deck. Hayley Matthews tries to smack it through the off side but gets beaten.
Back of a length, outside off, turning further away. Hayley Matthews shuffles and cuts it through point for a brace.
Short, wide of off. Henry slaps it to sweeper cover for a single.
A single to end the over! A length ball, jags back in from outside off. Henry goes back and pushes it to cover for a single.
Two dots in a row! Slower one, full and on off. Henry knocks it to the off side.
Fuller, in-line with the stumps. Henry jams it back to the bowler.
Full length, on off, nipping in. Hayley Matthews shuffles and eases it to mid on for one more.
A single now as this is tapped to mid off.
Misfield and four! This is sloppy. It is a length ball, on iff. Henry stays back and punches it to mid off. Maguire there makes a meal of it. The ball races away to the fence.

Drinks break! West Indies Women still have 8 wickets in hand. The game is evenly poised. Ireland Women will focus on taking wickets at regular intervals to put West Indies in a spot of bother. Hayley Matthews holds the key for them. If she sticks around for long, getting over the victory line will only get easier for them.
A single to end the over! A full toss, on leg. Henry whips it over mid-wicket and gets a single.
Full, outswinger, outside off. Hayley Matthews stays on her back foot and punches it through the line to sweeper cover. One taken.
Fuller and on leg, Hayley Matthews eases it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Hayley Matthews is on a roll here. It is short, wide of off. Hayley Matthews waits for it and cuts it late past backward point. It races away to the fence.
Length and on off, pushed to point.

FOUR! This should settle some nerves. Easy pickings for the West Indies skipper. It is full, on leg. Hayley Matthews flicks it off her pads to deep square leg. The fielder is the put in a valiant effort but in vain.
Back of a length, on top of off. Henry makes some room and pushes it gently towards cover. A wicket-taking over comes to an end here. West Indies Women need 90 runs in 66 balls.
Full one, drifting into the pads. Hayley Matthews nudges it to mid-wicket for a single.
A bit short, outside off. Henry stays back and goes for the cut shot. It takes a thick inside edge and goes to fine leg. One taken.
Chinelle Henry is the new batter in.

OUT! LBW! Laura Delany makes an appeal for lbw and the dreaded finger goes up. It looks to be plumb. Shemaine Campbelle has a long chat with her skipper and takes the review. It is a length ball, that lands on outside off and jags back in. Shemaine Campbelle tries to defend it out but gets beaten on the inside edge. The UltraEdge confirms no bat it is involved. The Ball Tracking shows three reds and Shemaine Campbelle is a goner. Ireland Women now have a sniff here.
FOUR! Nicely played. Fuller. drifitng down leg. Shemaine Campbelle gets low and sweeps it to fine leg for four runs.
It is full, angled in around off. Shemaine Campbelle almost chips it back to the bowler. It lands short of Laura Delany.
Slightly shorter and on off, Shemaine Campbelle cuts it to covers for one.

Bowls it on middle and leg, slightly shorter in length, Shemaine Campbelle looks to sweep it but gets rapped on her pads. A loud appeal but the finger stays down. Ireland Women decide to go upstairs. Ultra Edge shows no spike and Ball Tracking shows it was just clipping the bails and the umpires' decision stands NOT OUT!
Bowls it on middle, Hayley Matthews tucks it to mid on for one.

Flatter and on off, Shemaine Campbelle pulls it to mid-wicket for one.
